name: currencydesk-os
//: react, react-dom and @babel/standalone are PINNED EXACTLY, on purpose. react and react-dom are served to the browser from web/vendor, copied out of node_modules by `npm run build:site`; @babel/standalone compiles the JSX at build time in `npm run build:os` and never reaches a browser. A caret on any of them would let npm resolve a different version than the one the built output was produced with, which is the kind of drift nothing here would notice.

scripts.build: npm run build:onboarding && npm run build:site && npm run build:os
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:parse && npm run test:e2e
